ASUS Prime GeForce RTX 5070 Ti OC Edition 16GB GDDR6X Graphics Card

Unleash high-end next-generation gaming and AI computing power with the ASUS Prime GeForce RTX 5070 Ti OC Edition 16GB GDDR6X graphics card, distributed via Turbo Computer Egypt. Built on NVIDIA's latest architecture, this premium GPU features a massive 16GB of ultra-fast GDDR6X memory matrix to dominate 4K resolution gaming and complex creative workflows. The sleek 2.5-slot compact design is specifically engineered for excellent compatibility with small form factor (SFF) builds without compromising thermal capacity. Equipped with a triple-fan setup utilizing dual ball fan bearings and an optimized heatsink array, it delivers quiet yet extreme cooling performance under full loads. Officially factory overclocked for out-of-the-box performance boosts, this high-tier GPU infrastructure is backed by a 3-year official warranty.
